name: wagtail-modeladmin
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "wagtail-modeladmin" %}
{% set version = "2.5.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/wagtail_modeladmin-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 0f86e96d5172437e14f6e5fd986bae9648f499c117dff3bf6b2f9844ea9f440e

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - flit-core >=3.2,<4
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - wagtail >=5.0
    # - sphinxcontrib-spelling <9.0,>=8.0
    # - sphinx_copybutton >=0.5

test:
  imports:
    - wagtail_modeladmin
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

  home: https://github.com/wagtail-nest/wagtail-modeladmin
